title: Rav Anan bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a student of Shmuel, as we find that he said: "Many times I stood before Shmuel" ([Pesachim 101](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.101a.4); [Ketubot 61](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.61a.13)), and he said: "It was explained to me by Master Shmuel himself" (Moed Katan 18b).
Hyman cites Sanhedrin 96b: Rav Anan bar Tachlifa sent to Rav Yosef — it should read Rav Chanan, according to the version of Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: Pesachim has Anan say that he stood before Shmuel many times, while Ketubot describes one occasion. The letter to Rav Yosef is at [Sanhedrin 97b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.97b.3) in the consulted text, which reads Rav Chanan bar Tachlifa. [Heilprin’s Chanan entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1418&lang=en) cites the same passage. The cited Moed Katan wording remains unlocated.
